summary: Standards (the test passes without proving the real path): L2.batch-preflight builds a last item that breaks a constraint on arguments a document cannot carry, so a conforming tool is failed. plan_batch (input_plan.rs:628-637) splits the broken invocation with Spec{operands:true}, which keeps flag-only options on argv; the item the batch carries lacks them and breaks nothing. plan_pointers has the guard for exactly this (input_plan.rs:526-531, on_flag_only) and plan_batch does not. Real run: canon L2, 'L2.batch-preflight fail: export: a last item that breaks atMostOne [limit, all] was not refused with USAGE (exit 2): answered ok (exit 0)'; canon schema export shows limit and all flagOnly true, constraints atMostOne [limit, all] and input.batch true, so the false failure is already there and stays after canon-0-35-claim-l2 flips the claim. Probe on the conforming fake with clear-note made flagOnly in member tag (a batch command with atMostOne [note, clear-note]): L2.batch-preflight fails with the same message. Blast radius: any batch command with a constraint on a flag-only argument (every 1.2 tool with limit/all/cursor/fields on a command that takes a batch; tool-added flag-only options); blocks the L2 claim of canon. Fix is the plan_pointers guard in plan_batch.
